sonnet.problem: The story card says 'Then come the armies of heaven, on white horses.' This tells the baker the armies come after the rider, which gives away the answer to the next card (card 7, 'ride out ahead of the rider' is False).
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card says the beast in 19:19 is 'the one he saw rising out of the sea (Revelation 13:1).' No verse says outright that the beast of Revelation 19 is the beast of Revelation 13:1, so the card makes that link on its own.
sonnet.rule: He says two names mean the same person only when a verse says so outright, and he gives that verse.
